##### Source: Dungeon Master's Guide (Scimitar of Speed)

*Weapon ([machete](/weapon:machete)), very rare (requires installation)*

**Specs:** Variable, $$2,500,000

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this technical weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a bonus action on each of your turns.
